answer: Latency-fingerprint witness: each agent embeds a hardware-timed pulse whose propagation through the physical network (vine-like routing hops, jitter under load, response to injected gale of probe traffic) yields a signature tied to one physical endpoint. Hollow clones replaying messages inherit the operator’s timing but diverge under concurrent probes, since a single host cannot occupy two distinct network positions simultaneously. Attacker cost: one physical host and uplink per identity, plus continuous probe-response compute—sybil scale becomes hardware scale, not registration cost.
